assumptions.assumption: Naturally aligned 4/8 byte RISC-V reservations fit one 4096 byte translated page
assumptions.basis: Zalrsc requires natural alignment; page translation granularity in bridges; because N in {4,8} divides4096, an N-aligned address has page offset at most4096-N and its N-byte operand cannot cross that page
assumptions.dependent_result: Translation and permissions checked before domain lock
assumptions.stress_test: last aligned word/doubleword and virtual aliases with write-denied SC
assumptions.falsification_probe: A 4/8 byte aligned operation crosses a 4096 byte page or translation callback maps sub-page spans
